Formerly the most popular pattern for the great slope joseki (taisha)—and fairly successful—it's now seen as bad as far as AIs are concerned. 

See [Michael Redmond's Go TV, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 7, Qiao Zhijian 4p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YJDCyB6qDws&t=262s)
